svg.title: Why the search shows no Paperless documents
svg.desc: jamie searches for invoice and doesn't see document 412 under Paperless documents. Six questions, one after the other, find the cause. Is Search connected services switched on, or is Paperless trusted in the settings? If not, switch it on, again after every reload of the page. Is there an archive account in the settings? If not, enter the account that owns the synchronized files. Does Search problems in the settings list failed searches? If so, fix the error that it names. Does Paperless find document 412 for the term, signed in as the account of the API token? If not, let that account view the document, or rebuild the index of Paperless with document_index reindex. Does the archive account have a file with [P412] in its name? If not, let the synchronization write it, and scan an external storage with occ files:scan. Can jamie open that file? If not, share the file or its folder read-only with jamie. Then document 412 shows under Paperless documents.
